notes.title: Awesome Plans For The Future
notes.notes:
I have currently been working on a new game called Bravado which comes out on November, 2nd.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/966370/Bravado/

Once I have finished this project, I plan on completely remaking Micro Miners. The general idea will be the same, however, the game will be 3d and a lot more fun. There will be tons of new features that will make the game enjoyable even after all the main rewards have been unlocked.
More information will be released after Bravado has been finished.
